# Gold Coast Window and Pressure Cleaning — markdown mirror index

> Every page on this site has a plain markdown mirror: the content without
> navigation, scripts or layout chrome.

Fetch any page as markdown by appending `.md` to its URL
(/window-cleaning.md), by appending `index.md` (/window-cleaning/index.md),
or by sending `Accept: text/markdown`.

The full list of mirror URLs is written into this file at build time by
scripts/generate_markdown_mirrors.py, which walks the built site. This
checked-in copy is the fallback: it exists so the URL is never a 404 on a
build that skipped the mirror step.

## Markdown Mirrors

- [Sitemap index](https://gcwindowandpressurecleaning.com.au/sitemap.xml) — every page on this site
- [llms.txt](https://gcwindowandpressurecleaning.com.au/llms.txt) — services, pricing, suburbs, hours, FAQs
